title.en: IoT Smart Energy & AC Automation for Resorts in Bali and Jakarta
title.id: Otomasi Energi & AC Cerdas Berbasis IoT untuk Resort di Bali dan Jakarta

desc.en: Cutting utility bills by 28% using occupancy sensors, Zigbee gateways, and automated temperature curve scheduling.
desc.id: Mengurangi tagihan listrik sebesar 28% menggunakan sensor hunian kamar, gateway Zigbee, dan penjadwalan suhu dinamis.

body.en:
Cutting utility bills by 28% using occupancy sensors, Zigbee gateways, and automated temperature curve scheduling.

The Cost of Unregulated Air Conditioning in Tropical Resorts

Air conditioning represents over 65% of hotel electricity bills in tropical destinations like Bali. Guests frequently leave balcony doors wide open or keep AC units running at 16°C while away on day tours.

10xexecution speed acceleration
94%reduction in manual data entry errors
sub-50msend-to-end processing latency

ESP32 & Zigbee Environmental Telemetry

We deployed non-invasive door contact sensors and PIR presence detectors connected to low-power ESP32 microcontrollers that bridge over MQTT to a centralized property automation controller.

Dynamic Setback Algorithms

When a room remains unoccupied for over 35 minutes or patio doors are detected open, the automation system adjusts AC setpoints to an energy-saving 25°C curve without shutting the compressor down abruptly.

Enterprise Automation Worker Pipeline
from celery import Celery
import redis

celery_app = Celery("enterprise_automation", broker="redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0")

@celery_app.task(bind=True, max_retries=3, default_retry_delay=60)
def process_data_pipeline_job(self, task_payload: dict):
    try:
        validated_data = validate_enterprise_schema(task_payload)
        sync_to_database(validated_data)
        return {"success": True, "count": len(validated_data)}
    except Exception as exc:
        raise self.retry(exc=exc)

Measurable Financial and Environmental Impact

Across an 84-villa pilot in Seminyak, utility expenses dropped by $4,100 per month, extending compressor operating lifespan and paying for hardware deployment within four months.
